name: uk-land-registry-mcp
description: HM Land Registry open data: sold prices, House Price Index, corporate and overseas ownership, title boundaries and due-diligence flags for England and Wales.
long_description:
Query HM Land Registry's open data from your assistant.

**Works immediately, no account needed:** sold prices for every property sale registered in England and Wales since 1995, the official UK House Price Index, and postcode lookups.

**With a free HM Land Registry API key:** which companies own which titles (including overseas companies and their jurisdictions of incorporation), INSPIRE title boundary polygons, and registered lease and restrictive covenant flags. These datasets are published as monthly bulk files rather than a query API, so they are downloaded once into a local DuckDB cache on your machine.

Nothing is sent anywhere except the government endpoints being queried. There is no telemetry.

Contains HM Land Registry data © Crown copyright and database right, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Not legal advice, and not a substitute for official Land Registry searches.

hmlr_api_key.title: HM Land Registry API key
hmlr_api_key.description: Optional. Register free at use-land-property-data.service.gov.uk and accept the licence for each dataset you want. Needed only for ownership, boundary and due-diligence tools — sold prices, the House Price Index and postcode lookups work without it.

data_dir.title: Dataset cache location
data_dir.description: Where downloaded bulk datasets are stored. The corporate ownership dataset is several hundred megabytes, so choose a drive with room.
